title: 安田記念の後に・故に、怪物

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki races with no holds barred, but the audience is unshaken in their support for Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno asks me why she can't surpass Oguri Cap no matter how well she does.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After thinking on it for a while, I decide that it must be because Oguri Cap turns the support of her fans into more power to run. In that case, she's only going to get stronger from here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki needs a secret weapon of her own. I believe that her competitive spirit could be that weapon, but it could be a double-edged sword.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to keep that thought to myself for now and tell her I'll search for other ways. We decide to make the Takarazuka Kinen our next goal.
